in_marathi.name: Prafull
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Full of light
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prafull हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Prafulla means 'full of light', 'brimming with wisdom', and 'beauty in abundance'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prabhā', which means 'brightness, light'. The name is often given to babies born during the winter solstice, when the sun is at its brightest.

in_bengali.name: Prafull
